rows.label: How they are chosen
rows.a: Elected indirectly by an electoral college.
rows.b: Not elected. The President appoints by warrant under hand and seal (Article 155).

rows.label: Term
rows.b: Five years, but holds office during the President's pleasure (Article 156).

rows.label: Removal
rows.a: Impeachment by Parliament for violation of the Constitution (Article 61).
rows.b: No impeachment. Holds office at the President's pleasure.

rows.label: Pardoning power
rows.a: Article 72: court martial and death sentences.
rows.b: Article 161: offences against state laws. Cannot pardon a death sentence.

rows.label: Ordinances
rows.a: Article 123, when either House is not in session.
rows.b: Article 213, when the state legislature is not in session.

rows.label: Bills
rows.a: Article 111: assent, withhold, or return (not Money Bill) for reconsideration.
rows.b: Article 200: assent, withhold, return (not Money Bill), or reserve for the President's consideration.

en.takeaway: The President can be removed only by impeachment. A Governor holds office at the President's pleasure and can be removed earlier, with no impeachment.

rows.b: चुने नहीं जाते; राष्ट्रपति वारंट और मुहर से नियुक्त करते हैं (अनुच्छेद 155)।

rows.label: हटाना

rows.b: अनुच्छेद 161: राज्य कानूनों के अपराध। मृत्युदंड माफ़ नहीं कर सकते।

rows.label: अध्यादेश

rows.b: अनुच्छेद 200: सहमति, रोक, वापसी (धन विधेयक को छोड़कर), या राष्ट्रपति के विचार हेतु आरक्षित।

hi.takeaway: याद रखें: राष्ट्रपति को केवल महाभियोग से हटाया जा सकता है। राज्यपाल राष्ट्रपति की इच्छा तक पद पर रहते हैं, इसलिए उन्हें पहले भी हटाया जा सकता है, बिना महाभियोग के।
